credibility.line: Consistently delivers within stated EBITDA margin ranges while revenue growth accelerated to 14.5% by Sep 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue growth accelerated from -0.1% in Dec 2024 to 14.5% YoY in Sep 2026, aligning with upbeat guidance.
EBITDA margins remained disciplined, printing between 22.0% and 24.0% across quarters matching the guided mid-term ranges.
While operating cash flow was robust at Rs 10,999 crore in Mar 2026, OCF/PAT dropped to 0.73 from 1.50 in FY24.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated over four quarters, reaching 14.5% YoY in Sep 2026.
Practically debt-free balance sheet with a D/E ratio of 0.03 as of Sep 2026.
High profitability metrics demonstrated by a ROCE of 28.4% and ROE of 31.0%.
bear: Operating cash flow to PAT ratio weakened to 0.73 in Mar 2026 down from 1.50 in Mar 2024.
EBITDA margin softened to 22.0% in Sep 2026, hitting the lower bound of the medium-term 22% to 24% range.
Free cash flow declined to Rs 9,667 crores in Mar 2026 compared to Rs 14,012 crores in Mar 2024.
watch: Whether EBITDA margin recovers from the 22.0% reported in Sep 2026.
Continuation of the revenue acceleration trend beyond the 14.5% reported in Sep 2026.
Improvement in OCF/PAT conversion from the 0.73 level recorded in Mar 2026.
